name: Joint Learning of Implicit Surface and Meshing
definition: An end-to-end method to optimize both SDF and reconstructed meshes jointly, predicting surface meshes from images. It relies neither on explicit mesh data nor proxy meshes.
summary: Joint Learning of Implicit Surface and Meshing optimizes a Signed Distance Function and mesh end-to-end from images, eliminating the need for explicit mesh training data or proxy meshes.
